item.title: 9月賭收創今年新低現客多消費降新常態 專家解構轉型機遇與全年展望
item.description:
https://www.allinmedia.com.hk/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/10月7日.mp4 根據博彩監察協調局（DICJ）最新公佈的數據顯示，本澳今年9月份博彩毛收入為180.63億澳門元，按月下跌約17.49%，創下今年以來單月賭收最低紀錄。澳大博彩研究所所長馮家超分析指，這是因新政策衍生出的全新旅遊與消費現象，業界與學術界需要時間去適應與觀察。但他對賭收全年達標機會依然樂觀。負責任博彩協會會長宋偉傑則認為，旅客來澳的旅遊模式與博彩收益之間的差距正顯著擴大。
政策紅利與通關便利：引發「同人多次往返」新常態
針對9月賭收創新低但入境旅客未見大減的現象，澳門大學國際綜合度假村管理副教授、博彩研究所所長馮家超進一步剖析，這與近期實施的多項全新入境簽證政策（如珠海「一周一行」、橫琴團客多次往返等便利措施）息息相關。 他指出，這些新政策導致入境旅客數量增加，但實質上是「同一個人頻繁往返」。旅客來澳旅遊本有固定預算，雖然因簽注便利令入境次數增加，但總消費預算並未成比例放大。
與此同時，澳門統計暨普查局數據亦顯示，2026年上半年留宿旅客則約805萬人次，增幅僅0.2%；而不過夜的旅客約1,289萬人次，大幅增長15.3%，許多旅客選擇當日往返原居地或在鄰近地區過夜，因此拉低了人均博彩與整體過夜消費表現。馮家超強調，這並非單純的短期經濟週期波動，而是因新政策衍生出的全新旅遊與消費現象，業界與學術界需要時間去適應與觀察。
全年賭收展望樂觀 專家獻策深化非博彩轉型與承載力提升
至於全年賭收表現，馮家超預測今年全年博彩毛收入可望落在 2,500 億至 2,600 億澳門元之間，接近年初的預期目標，第四季（10月至12月）每月平均賭收若維持約 210 億至 220 億元左右，全年達標機會依然樂觀。針對非博彩元素與國際客源的貢獻，他認為大方向正確，有助分散下行風險，但目前國際客源的實際數據因統計限制而低於真實情況，短期內要全面填補高端客群下降的缺口仍具挑戰。
展望未來新常態，馮家超建議除了深化大灣區各城市的市場滲透、配合旅客偏好推動高品質非博彩活動（如演唱會、拳擊賽事等）外，更應長遠增加酒店房間供應與過夜承載能力，才能有效延長旅客逗留時間，進一步帶動全方位的餐飲與博彩消費增長。
旅客轉向「體驗式消費」致賭數減少
澳門負責任博彩協會會長宋偉傑受訪時表示，目前旅客來澳的旅遊模式與博彩收益之間的差距正顯著擴大。以往澳門博彩業以貴賓廳（VIP）為主力，人均博彩消費基數較大；隨著新博彩法實施及貴賓廳業務進行調整，VIP客群大幅減少，高額投注數字隨之下降。當前赴澳旅客已轉向以「體驗式消費」為主，博彩消費相應減少，這正是導致「客量多、人均博彩消費降」的主因。
宋偉傑認為，中場旅客的消費雖然較為平均、單筆金額不如過往貴賓廳龐大，但能避免賭收出現「大上大落」的極端波動。從數據來看，轉型至中場為主後，本澳博彩收益已漸趨穩定，行業整體風險相對降低，有利於朝向健康、多元與可持續的方向發展。

item.title: Judiciary Police Receive Reports of Fake Douyin Customer Service Scams Involving Over MOP 2.3 Million
item.description:
>
Judiciary Police Receive Reports of Fake Douyin Customer Service Scams Involving Over MOP 2.3 Million Scams impersonating customer service assistants of Douyin (the Chinese mainland version of TikTok) have resurfaced in Macau. The Judiciary Police have recently received three related cases, involving a total loss of over MOP 2.3 million. The largest single loss exceeded MOP 2 million, and no arrests have been made thus far.   The cases involve three local victims (two males and one female), ranging from middle-aged to elderly individuals. The incidents occurred on the afternoon and evening of October 5. The scammers called the victims, claiming to be Douyin staff members, and falsely alleged that the victims had activated a Douyin live-streaming membership for which an MOP 800 service fee would be charged. They offered to assist in canceling the fee.   The scammers then provided a purported IP address, contacted the victims via WhatsApp, and further guided them to enable the screen-sharing function on their mobile phones. Under the pretext of checking account statements and investigating virtual transactions, the scammers lured the victims into logging into their mobile banking and electronic payment accounts, and handing over credit card information.   The three victims subsequently received bank transfer notification SMS messages and found out that their account deposits had been completely drained. They then discovered they had been scammed and reported the cases to the police for assistance. The Judiciary Police are currently following up and investigating the cases.   Regarding this scam, Allin subsequently received a tip-off from a reader who recounted a personal experience of receiving a “Douyin customer service” scam call. The reader stated that he had received a call from a man speaking Cantonese with an accent. The caller accurately stated the reader’s surname, and claimied that a Douyin live-streaming service had been activated and that an MOP 800 membership fee needed to be collected. Fortunately, the reader was sharp-witted, instantly exposing the caller as a fraudster and threatening to call the police, causing the scammer to hang up.   In addition, the reader reported that he was being constantly plagued by various nuisance calls recently, revealing that starting the day after activating a Hong Kong phone number service (One Number, Multi-SIM) through a certain telecommunications company, they began continuously receiving promotional calls from various insurance companies, banks, and medical institutions in Hong Kong.

item.title: 澳娛綜合舉行國慶酒會 何超鳳稱續為澳門發展貢獻力量
item.description:
>
澳娛綜合舉行國慶77週年酒會 澳娛綜合聯同澳娛綜合員工福利諮詢委員會（福諮會）及澳娛綜合勞資協商委員會，於今日（8日）在上葡京舉行「慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年國慶酒會」。常務董事何超鳳稱，澳娛綜合將繼續發揮自身優勢，融入國家發展大局，為澳門高質量發展貢獻力量。 澳娛綜合度假股份有限公司董事局主席霍震霆、常務董事何超鳳、勞資協商委員會顧問黃顯輝、董事兼福諮會主席梁安琪、董事霍啟山及秘書長官樂怡等，聯同逾2,000名員工歡聚一堂，共賀國慶，祝願祖國繁榮昌盛、澳門和諧穩定。 何超鳳致辭時表示，澳娛綜合植根澳門六十多年，背靠祖國、立足澳門，始終與祖國同心同行、與澳門共同成長。面對國家「十五五」規劃開局、澳門特區啟動「三五規劃」，以及大灣區和橫琴深合區加快建設所帶來的新機遇，澳娛綜合將繼續發揮自身優勢，圍繞綠色發展、琴澳融合和「旅遊+」創新三大方向，推動企業穩步向前。她指出，企業只有融入國家發展大局，才能成就自身更大前景。澳娛綜合將繼續把握時代脈搏、堅持守正創新，為澳門高質量發展貢獻力量。 梁安琪致辭時指出，澳娛綜合一直堅持愛國愛澳、立足本土、回饋社會的初心；福諮會亦秉持何鴻燊博士「以人為本」的企業理念，用心關懷員工。她感謝澳娛綜合團隊的辛勤付出，並表示未來將與員工並肩共迎機遇、共創佳績。 作為澳門首家開展系統化愛國教育課程及紅色之旅的綜合旅遊休閒企業，澳娛綜合過去十年持續透過全國兩會精神分享會、江西井岡山愛國主義教育培訓課程，以及「我和我的祖國灣區行」等項目，深化團隊成員對國家發展的認識，厚植家國情懷，鼓勵團隊把握國家及澳門發展機遇。

item.title: Macau’s September Gross Gaming Revenue Drops by 17.49%
item.description:
https://www.allinmedia.com.hk/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/10月7日.mp4 Macau’s gross gaming revenue (GGR) for September stood at MOP 18.063 billion, representing a month-on-month decrease of approximately 17.49% and hitting the lowest monthly record for the year, according to the latest data released by the Gaming Inspection and Coordination Bureau (DICJ),
Davis Fong, Director of Institute for the Study of Commercial Gaming at the University of Macau, analyzed that this phenomenon stems from new tourism and consumption trends generated by new policies, requiring time for both the industry and academia to observe and adapt. Nevertheless, he remains optimistic about achieving the full-year GGR target. Meanwhile, Billy Song, President of Macau Responsible Gaming Association, noted that the gap between visitors’ travel patterns and gaming revenues is widening significantly.
Policy Dividends and Facilitated Custom Clearance: Triggering the New Normal of “Frequent Multiple Entries by the Same Individuals”
Addressing the paradox of September’s record-low GGR alongside resilient inbound visitor numbers, Davis Fong, Associate Professor in Integrated Resort and Tourism Management and Director of Institute for the Study of Commercial Gaming at the University of Macau, explained that this is closely tied to recently implemented entry visa policies (such as Zhuhai’s “one trip per week” and multiple-entry measures for Hengqin tour groups).
He pointed out that these new policies have increased visitor arrival counts, but in reality, they reflect “the same individuals traveling back and forth frequently.” Visitors come to Macau with fixed travel budgets; although visa convenience increases their frequency of entry, their total spending budget does not scale up proportionally.
Meanwhile, data from the Statistics and Census Service (DSEC) showed that in the first half of 2026, overnight visitors reached approximately 8.05 million, a marginal increase of 0.2%, whereas same-day (non-overnight) visitors surged by 15.3% to about 12.89 million. Many visitors chose to return home the same day or stay in neighboring regions, pulling down per capita gaming and overall overnight spending performance. Fong emphasized that this is not merely a short-term economic cycle fluctuation, but rather a brand-new tourism and consumption phenomenon spawned by new policies, which the industry and academia need time to observe and adapt to.
Optimistic Full-Year GGR Outlook: Experts Offer Strategies to Deepen Non-Gaming Transformation and Enhance Carrying Capacity
Regarding full-year gaming revenue performance, Fong projected that total GGR for the year is expected to land between MOP 250 billion and MOP 260 billion, close to the initial target set at the beginning of the year. If the average monthly GGR for the fourth quarter (October to December) maintains around MOP 21 billion to MOP 22 billion, the chance of hitting the full-year target remains optimistic. Regarding the contribution of non-gaming elements and international source markets, he believes the general direction is correct and helps mitigate downside risks. However, due to statistical limitations, current actual data for international visitors underrepresents reality, making it challenging in the short term to fully bridge the gap left by the decline in high-end clientele.
Looking ahead to the new normal, Fong suggested that aside from deepening market penetration across Greater Bay Area cities and promoting high-quality non-gaming activities tailored to traveler preferences (such as concerts and boxing matches), Macau should also expand hotel room supply and overnight carrying capacity in the long run. This is essential to effectively extend visitors’ length of stay and further drive comprehensive growth in dining and gaming consumption.
Shift Toward “Experiential Consumption” Leads to Decline in Gaming Figures
In an interview, Billy Song, President of Macau Responsible Gaming Association, stated that the gap between current visitor travel patterns and gaming revenue is widening significantly. Historically, Macau’s gaming industry was anchored by VIP rooms, boasting a higher baseline of per capita gaming spend. With the implementation of the new Gaming Law and subsequent adjustments to VIP operations, the VIP clientele has dropped significantly, leading to a decline in high-rolling figures. Today’s visitors to Macau have shifted toward experiential consumption, resulting in a corresponding decrease in gaming spend, which is the primary reason behind the phenomenon of high visitor volume accompanied by lower per capita gaming expenditure.
Song believes that although mass-market visitors have more moderate spending patterns with single-transaction amounts lower than past VIP levels, this stability helps prevent extreme fluctuations in GGR. Judging by the data, following the transition to a mass-market-led model, Macau’s gaming revenue has gradually stabilized, lowering overall industry risk and favoring a healthy, diversified, and sustainable direction of development.

item.title: Sands Launches Basketball Charity Week: Star-Studded Event Promotes Greater Bay Area Youth Sports Exchange
item.description:
>
Sands Launches Basketball Charity Week: Star-Studded Event Promotes Greater Bay Area Youth Sports Exchange With the return of NBA Games China to Macao, the “NBA Cares × Sands Cares Basketball Charity Week 2026,” jointly organized by Sands China Ltd. and NBA Cares, held its official launch ceremony today (October 8) at The Venetian Macao Cotai Arena. This marks the full rollout of the five-day large-scale sports and charity series running from October 7 to 11. Around 500 guests gathered at the venue, including active players from the Dallas Mavericks and the Houston Rockets—the two teams competing in the NBA China Games—alongside NBA executives, NBA legends, Sands management, and Macao student basketball athletes. The event successfully extends the excitement of a world-class basketball spectacle from the competitive arena directly into the local community. The launch day was star-studded, featuring special appearances by NBA legends Yao Ming and Shawn Marion. Active players from the Mavericks and Rockets stepped into the roles of youth mentors, interacting and sharing hands-on basketball skills with Macao’s school competition championship teams—the Division D girls’ team from Keang Peng School and the Division D boys’ team from Colégio Dom Bosco (Yuet Wah). Alongside Sands Cares Ambassadors, the players and local students worked together to assemble care packs to be distributed to community members, bringing the ethos of charity and community care to life. Patrick Dumont, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Las Vegas Sands and Governor of the Dallas Mavericks, stated at the event that the group has deep roots in Macao for over two decades. He hopes to leverage the extended impact of the tournament to harness the power of sports in uniting communities and inspiring youth, continuously supporting Macao’s “Tourism+” strategy and the building of a harmonious community. This year’s charity week has scaled up significantly compared to previous editions, expanding its participant demographic across the entire Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. The series kicked off early on October 7 with the opening “Youth Basketball Day” held at the Macao East Asian Games Dome. A total of 150 young players aged 11 to 14 from eight Macao schools, alongside 50 youth participants from Hong Kong and mainland cities in the Greater Bay Area, took part in training sessions and matches. A star-studded coaching lineup featuring two-time NBA champion and Hall of Famer Ray Allen, NBA coaches, Chinese basketball star Ding Yanyuhang, and Chinese women’s basketball player Zhang Ziyu led the youth from the three regions through professional training on footwork, dribbling, and offense-defense strategies. Young players were mixed into cross-regional teams for friendly youth exhibition matches and an individual skills challenge. Awards were presented after the matches to commend outstanding young athletes, narrowing the distance between youth in Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macao through practical competition and building bridges of friendship. The “Youth Basketball Day” also featured a “Her Court” panel discussion, inviting Dawn Smyth, NBA Vice President, International Basketball Operations; Gina Miller, Chief Communications Officer of the Dallas Mavericks; Gretchen Sheirr, President of the Houston Rockets; and Winnie Yu, Senior Vice President and Chief Resort Marketing Officer of Sands China Ltd., as guest speakers. They shared their personal growth and professional journeys, encouraging the younger generation to build self-confidence and bravely pursue their goals. Wilfred Wong, Executive Vice Chairman of Sands China Ltd., expressed gratitude to the Macao SAR Government and all sectors of society for their staunch support. This marks the second consecutive year that the group has leveraged the NBA China Games platform to bring positive sports energy into the community. By expanding the event’s reach to the Greater Bay Area this year, the initiative strengthens regional youth connections and inspires the next generation through special thematic seminars. Moving forward, Sands China will continue to align with the SAR Government’s direction of moderate economic diversification, promoting the deep integration of sports and tourism to polish Macao’s name card as a “City of Sports.” According to organizers, the charity week will run through October 11. Following the launch day, tomorrow (October 9) will feature the “Campus Day” at Yuet Wah College, continuing to pass on the spirit of sportsmanship and charitable warmth to even more youths across the Greater Bay Area through basketball.

item.title: 「2027永利臻典—中國葡萄酒大賽」11月全面啟動
item.description:
>
「2027永利臻典——中國葡萄酒大賽」 11月全面啟動 由永利度假村旗下高端生活方式品牌「Wynn Signature 永利臻典」打造的「永利臻典 中國葡萄酒大賽」，宣告將於2026年11月9日發佈2027年賽程安排及推廣藍圖。賽事預計於2027年3月1日開放報名，評審週於8月在北京舉行，年度頒獎典禮則擬於10月底在澳門舉行。 本屆賽事迎來重大突破，評審週將首度走出澳門、移師北京舉行。屆時由全球專家組成的國際權威評審團將齊聚首都，深入體驗在地風土與餐飲文化，推動中國佳釀走向世界。 大賽影響力獲國際高度認可，於2026年8月榮獲亞太區權威公關獎項 SABRE Awards Asia-Pacific 品牌建設類別最高榮譽 Diamond SABRE Award，成為該類別唯一獲獎者。 為持續推廣獲獎佳釀，永利已展開多元布局，包括參與「食界精緻餐飲投資論壇」、推出深圳餐酒晚宴、協助策劃雲南德欽葡萄酒旅遊路線，並將參展寧夏「第47屆世界葡萄與葡萄酒大會」及「Tatler Best Awards Asia-Pacific 2026」，向全球展示中國葡萄酒的極致魅力。

item.title: Grand Korea Leisure Q3 Operating Profit Expected to Drop 11.3%
item.description:
>
Grand Korea Leisure Q3 Operating Profit Expected to Drop 11.3% Grand Korea Leisure Co Ltd (GKL), a South Korean foreigner-only casino operator, is expected to post a third-quarter operating profit of KRW 15.4 billion (approx. US$11.5 million), representing a year-on-year decrease of 11.3%, according to a recent equity research report by KB Securities. The brokerage cited rising labor expenses as a key headwind squeezing the operator’s profitability margins.   In a report released on September 29, KB Securities noted that GKL’s Q3 gaming drop amount is expected to grow by 2.5% year-on-year, but the hold rate is projected to decline by 0.2 percentage points year-on-year, limiting revenue growth.   On the cost side, higher labor expenses will increase fixed costs, with GKL’s Q3 operating profit margin expected to fall from 15.8% in the same period last year to 14%.   10-Year Lease Renewal for COEX   Regarding GKL’s medium-to-long-term development, the brokerage firm noted that the company still needs further investment to secure long-term growth drivers. GKL previously announced that it had extended the lease for its Gangnam COEX casino in Seoul by 10 years, with the new term running from October 2026 to October 2035. KB pointed out that rental costs may rise following the renewal. Furthermore, as the COEX casino has been operating longer than other major casinos in South Korea, it has reached a stage requiring reinvestment and renovation, which may further push up future costs. The report noted that while GKL has maintained mid-single-digit annual revenue growth in recent years, market uncertainty regarding its medium-to-long-term growth prospects remains. The market had previously discussed the possibility of GKL constructing its own casino to seek new long-term growth drivers. However, KB believes that given the 10-year lease renewal for the COEX casino, the likelihood of implementing a self-built casino in the short term is low. KB’s operating profit forecasts for GKL for this year and next year are 12.2% and 14.3% lower than market consensus, respectively.   Impact of Tourism Promotion Development Fund Hike Expected to Be Limited   On the other hand, the South Korean gaming industry has recently focused on the government’s potential increase in the “Tourism Promotion Development Fund” levy, but KB believes the impact of such regulatory adjustments on GKL is limited. The report stated that because the revenue scale of GKL’s individual casinos is relatively modest, they are not expected to reach the threshold for higher levy rates; thus, even if the government raises fund levies on certain large-scale casinos, the direct impact on GKL will remain relatively limited. Overall, the brokerage firm considers GKL’s short-term earnings to be dragged down by the hold rate and labor costs, while post-renewal rent, renovation expenses for the COEX casino, and how the company identifies new medium-to-long-term growth drivers will serve as key factors for its future operations.   GKL Casino recorded gaming revenue of KRW 31.109 billion (approx. HK$181 million) in August, down 25.4% month-on-month and 11.3% year-on-year.

item.title: NBA關懷行動×金沙關懷籃球公益周今啟動 球星雲集推動大灣區青年體育交流
item.description:
>
NBA關懷行動×金沙關懷籃球公益周今啟動 適逢NBA中國賽2026落戶澳門，由金沙中國聯手NBA關懷行動（NBA Cares）合辦的「NBA關懷行動×金沙關懷籃球公益周2026」今日（8日）於澳門威尼斯人綜藝館舉行啟動日，標誌這一為期五日（10月7‑11日）的大型體育公益系列活動全面展開。現場匯集約500位嘉賓，包括達拉斯獨行俠、侯斯頓火箭兩支參戰NBA中國賽的現役球員、NBA管理層、傳奇球星、金沙集團管理團隊、澳門學界籃球健兒及中外傳媒，將世界級籃球盛事的熱力從競技賽場延伸至社區當中。 啟動日現場星光熠熠，NBA傳奇球星姚明、夏恩・馬利安（Shawn Marion）親臨支持；獨行俠與火箭隊現役球員化身青年導師，與澳門學界比賽冠軍隊——鏡平學校女子D組、鮑思高高華小學男子D組的學生互動切磋，傳授實戰籃球技巧。球員、本澳學生連同金沙關懷大使一同動手製作愛心禮包，把善意送給社區群眾，落實公益關懷理念。拉斯維加斯金沙集團董事會主席兼行政總裁、達拉斯獨行俠隊班主Patrick Dumont在活動上表示，集團紮根澳門二十餘載，期望藉賽事延伸效應，發揮體育凝聚社區、啟迪青年的力量，持續助力澳門「旅遊+」戰略與和諧社區建設。 本次公益周規模較往年進一步升級，參與群體擴展至整個粵港澳大灣區。系列活動早在10月7日已打響頭炮，首場「青少年籃球日」於澳門東亞運動會體育館舉行，來自澳門八所學校共150名11‑14歲青少年球員，連同50名香港及大灣區內地城市青年參與訓練及比賽。NBA兩屆總冠軍、籃球名人堂成員雷・阿倫（Ray Allen）聯同NBA教練、中國籃球名將丁彥雨航、中國女籃張子宇組成明星導師陣容，帶領三地青年開展步伐、運球、攻防專業訓練；青年球員跨地域混合編隊，展開男、女子友誼交流賽，同步舉辦個人技巧挑戰賽，賽後頒獎嘉許表現出色的小選手，透過實戰切磋拉近粵港澳青少年距離，搭建友誼橋樑。 「青少年籃球日」當日亦設置「女生主場」座談會，邀請NBA助理副總裁Dawn Smyth、達拉斯獨行俠隊首席傳播官Gina Miller、侯斯頓火箭隊總裁Gretchen Sheirr以及金沙中國高級副總裁兼首席度假村營銷總裁尤穎擔任嘉賓，分享女性成長與職場經歷，鼓勵年輕一代建立自信、勇於追尋目標。 金沙中國有限公司行政副主席王英偉感謝澳門特區政府及社會各界鼎力支持，這已是集團連續第二年借NBA中國賽平台把體育正能量帶入社區。今年將活動輻射到大灣區，加強區域青年連結，並透過專題座談啟迪新一代。未來金沙中國會繼續配合特區政府經濟適度多元發展方向，推動體育與旅遊深度融合，擦亮澳門「體育之城」的品牌名片。 據介紹，公益周會持續至10月11日，繼啟動日後，明日（10月9日）將走進粵華中學開展「校園日」，接續透過籃球運動，把體育精神與公益溫暖傳遞給更多大灣區青少年。

item.title: GKL第三季營業利潤料跌11% COEX賭場續租或推高營運成本
item.description:
>
GKL第三季營業利潤料跌11.3% 南韓國營賭場營運商GKL(Grand Korea Leisure Co. Ltd.)第三季盈利或遜於市場預期。南韓KB證券最新報告預計，GKL第三季營業利潤按年下跌11.3%至154億韓圜(約9,020萬港元)，主要受到賭場持有率下降及人工成本增加影響。 KB證券上月29日發表報告指，預計GKL第三季博彩投注額按年增長2.5%，但持有率料按年下降0.2%，限制收入增長。 成本方面，人工成本上升將增加固定開支，預計GKL第三季營業利潤率將由去年同期的15.8%降至14%。按賭場劃分，KB預計公司旗下七樂(Seven Luck)品牌的釜山賭場投注額錄得增長，首爾江南COEX賭場大致持平，而首爾龍山Dragon City賭場則可能倒退。 COEX續租10年　翻新或增加成本 對於GKL的中長期發展，券商認為，公司仍需進一步投資，以確保長期增長動力。GKL早前公佈，將首爾江南COEX賭場租約延長10年，新租期由2026年10月至2035年10月。KB指出，續租後租金可能上升，加上COEX賭場相較南韓其他主要賭場營運時間較長，已到了需要重新投資及翻新的階段，未來相關成本或進一步增加。 報告指出，GKL近年每年仍維持中單位數收入增長，但市場對其中長期增長前景仍存在不確定性。市場此前亦曾討論GKL自行興建賭場的可能性，以尋找新的長期增長動力。不過KB認為，考慮到公司已將COEX賭場續租10年，短期內落實自建賭場的可能性較低。KB對GKL今年及明年的營業利潤預測，分別較市場共識低12.2%及14.3%。 旅遊振興基金加徵影響料有限 另一方面，南韓博彩業近期關注政府可能提高「旅遊振興開發基金」徵費，但KB認為，相關制度調整對GKL的影響可能有限。報告指出，由於GKL旗下各賭場的收入規模相對不大，預計不會達到適用較高徵費率的門檻，因此即使政府提高部分大型賭場的基金徵費，GKL受到的直接影響亦相對有限。整體而言，券商認為GKL短期盈利受到持有率及人工成本拖累，而COEX賭場續租後的租金及翻新開支，以及公司如何尋找新的中長期增長動力，將成為未來營運的重要因素。 GKL賭場8月博彩收入為311.09億韓圜(約1.82億港元)，按月下跌25.4%，按年減少11.3%。

item.title: 司警破3宗假抖音客服電騙呃230萬 讀者智退騙徒帶出私隱危機
item.description:
>
司警連破3宗假抖音客服騙案涉呃逾230萬澳門元。(AI生成圖片) 假冒「抖音客服」詐騙手法再度在澳門出現，澳門司警近日接獲三宗相關報案，合共造成超過230萬元(澳門元、下同)損失，其中單一損失最大一宗超過200萬元，目前暫未有人被捕。 案件涉及三名本地事主，包括兩男一女，涵蓋中年人及長者。事發於本月5日下午至傍晚，騙徒致電事主自稱是抖音職員，訛稱事主已開通抖音直播會員，將收取800元服務費，但聲稱可協助取消相關費用。 騙徒隨後提供所謂的IP地址，並透過WhatsApp與事主取得聯絡，進一步引導事主開啟手機的屏幕共享功能。在查閱帳戶流水和排查虛擬交易等藉口下，騙徒誘騙事主登入手機銀行及電子支付帳戶，並交出信用卡資料。其中一名年長事主受騙情況尤為嚴重，更被要求交出身份證及提款卡資料。 三名事主其後陸續收到銀行的轉帳短訊通知，驚覺帳戶存款已被悉數轉走，方知受騙並報警求助，司警正對案件展開跟進調查。 關於這宗騙局，Allin隨後也接到一位讀者報料，講述曾接到同類「抖音客服」詐騙電話的親身經歷。該讀者表示，自己昨日(6日)也同樣接到假冒「抖音客服」的詐騙電話，來電者為一名講帶口音廣東話的男子，對方不但能準確說出其姓氏，還與司警案情出如一轍地訛稱開通了抖音直播、需收取800元會費。幸好讀者醒目即時拆穿對方為詐騙電話，並揚言報警，騙徒隨即心虛掛線。 該讀者在看到司警公佈三人被騙逾200萬元的相關新聞後，特意聯繫Allin分享經歷，並質疑騙徒集團的資料來源。此外，該讀者亦反映自己近期頻受各類滋擾電話困擾，並透露自透過某電訊公司開通香港電話號碼(一卡多號)服務後，翌日起便不斷接到來自香港不同保險公司、銀行及醫療機構的推銷電話，甚至向電訊公司投訴也只獲「愛莫能助」的回覆，令其對個人私隱外洩感到憂心忡忡。 面對層出不窮且手法層疊更新的電訊與網絡詐騙，以及隨之而來的個人資料外洩隱憂，澳門警方再次呼籲市民時刻保持高度警惕，切勿隨意向陌生人透露個人身份資料、銀行密碼，或開啟手機「屏幕共享」功能，如接獲可疑來電應立即掛斷並向相關部門求助，以免墮入陷阱造成財產損失。

item.title: NBA HOUSE威尼斯人開鑼 全面升級打造一站式籃球嘉年華
item.description:
>
NBA HOUSE 2026登陸澳門威尼斯人。 全面擴容升級的「澳門NBA HOUSE 2026」即日(7日)起至本月11日一連五天在澳門威尼斯人金光會展A及B館盛大舉行，每日上午11時至晚上10時免費開放。作為NBA中國賽2026的重要球迷互動平台，今年賽事攜手近30家全球知名品牌與參展商，打造集特色餐飲、音樂娛樂、時尚零售、科技互動及派對體驗於一體的全方位嘉年華，豐富澳門體育旅遊體驗。 今屆活動星光熠熠，多位NBA傳奇球星如雷阿倫(Ray Allen)、保沙(Carlos Boozer)、保殊(Chris Bosh)、林書豪、馬貝利(Stephon Marbury)、夏恩馬利安(Shawn Marion)、莫比利(Cuttino Mobley)、列治文(Mitch Richmond)、史高拿(Luis Scola) 及德加(P.J. Tucker)以及中國籃球明星丁彥雨航等將親臨現場與球迷近距離交流。此外，KiiiKiii、SB19、EVAN及MIRROR成員姜濤等亞洲明星藝人亦將獻上精彩表演。 場內亮點豐富，包含參賽球隊獨家主題展區、NBA獎盃合照體驗，以及數位LED球場上的「NBA深度賽場」挑戰。升級後的Merchandise Village商品專區匯聚NBA旗艦店與多個授權品牌，提供官方精品及個性化訂製服務；逾1,500平方米餐飲區則融合澳門特色與美國德州美食。 現場更設有兩場由淘寶88VIP呈獻的觀賽派對，普通入場無需事先註冊，讓廣大球迷在歡樂熱烈的氛圍中，共享世界級籃球盛事。

item.title: Gambling Rate Exceeds 30% Among Macau’s Senior Citizens
item.description:
https://www.allinmedia.com.hk/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/老年人賭博.mp4 According to a recent study on gambling behavior among Macau’s senior citizens, the gambling participation rate among the elderly has reached 31.8%, while the “gambling disorder rate” is 2.6. The study, which is released by the Yat On Center, points out that loneliness and insufficient social support are the main reasons causing seniors to fall into gambling disorder. Zeng Zhonglu, President of the Asia-Pacific Society for Gambling Studies, pointed out that with population aging, seniors’ entertainment demand for the gaming industry will continue to grow, and the proportion of elderly people in Macau’s gaming market is expected to continue to increase.
Zeng Zhonglu analyzed that this trend mainly stems from two realistic needs. One is killing time and social needs. Many seniors face the predicament of having nowhere to go and living a boring life after retirement, coupled with physical conditions that prevent them from engaging in heavy physical sports, making gambling a relatively convenient leisure consumption method. This is similar to the popular phenomenon among seniors in mainland China who play low-stakes mahjong as leisure gambling. The second is preventing brain decay. Brain cognitive decline is a major enemy of elderly health. Moderate puzzle games are regarded by many seniors as brain tonic. Frequently participating in gambling games with a thinking nature is considered, to a certain extent, helpful in reducing the risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease.
Zeng Zhonglu added that looking at data from mature gaming markets such as Las Vegas in the United States, senior customer groups account for a fairly high proportion, and Macau will likewise need to face the major trend of a continuous growth in its elderly gambling population in the future.
While the demand for gambling grows, the risk of seniors falling into gambling disorder cannot be ignored either. According to visits to Macau gambling counseling agencies, the proportion of seniors involved in recent help-seeking cases (including family members seeking help on their behalf) is close to 10% (9.6%), and the gambling disorder rate among help-seeking seniors is as high as 56%, far exceeding other age groups (about 30%).
Lao Mei I, Director of S.K.H 24 Hours Hotline and Online Gambling Counselling Services, pointed out that seniors’ willingness to proactively seek help is generally low, with most being sought help on their behalf by children or spouses after detecting abnormalities. Once a case comes to light, the elderly person’s gambling problem is often extremely severe.
“For many elderly people, directly asking them to quit gambling is equivalent to stripping away their social circle, emotional outlet, and self-worth. Therefore, gambling cessation counseling needs to deconstruct the needs at each of the above levels step by step.” Lao Mei I analyzed that the biggest difficulty in helping seniors quit gambling lies in the fact that gambling has been completely embedded in daily life, and when facing younger generations, they often deny the problem due to a sense of shame.
